ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is January to December, and the vertical axis is relative flow; the legend shows that the solid line represents inflow and the dashed line represents outflow. The solid-line inflow is relatively low in winter, January and December, gradually rises in spring, and the high-water period is mainly concentrated in May to September; among these, the main peak appears around June, there is some decline in July, another secondary peak appears around August, and afterward it gradually declines. The dashed-line outflow changes relatively gently, and is also higher in summer and lower in winter. Then reason: This intra-annual change reflects the hydrological characteristics of rivers in the monsoon region, with an obvious summer flood season and winter low-water period; among these, the main peak around June corresponds with concentrated precipitation during the plum-rain period in the Yangtze River Basin, and sustained high water in summer and low water in winter also conform to the hydrological process of the Yangtze River Basin. Therefore, this reservoir may be located in the Yangtze River Basin.
